label: Peer and recovery support
description: Peer support specialists, recovery coaches, recovery drop-in centers and mutual-aid meetings.

description: Services for people leaving jail or prison.

description: Inpatient, residential, withdrawal management and room and board for treatment.

label: Other or unclassified
